IISTA · Internship Open

ISTA Scientific Internships — Year-Round

Host-arranged scientific internships in Austria in natural sciences, mathematics and computing.

STIPEND / MONTH
€1,583
Stipend details
Minimum gross salary of €1,583 per month under an employment contract with ISTA.
Entry deadline
To be confirmed
Format & location
In person · Klosterneuburg, Austria
Who can apply
Current/completed bachelor’s or master’s students in eligible science and related disciplines.
Accommodation & support
Housing not free (campus flats can be rented, subject to availability) · no travel funding · visa documents provided for non-EU/EEA applicants · no application fee

Entry notes

  • Rolling host-contact process; register formally at least two months before arrival.
  • Internship
